scope: Consolidating audit of already executed AP3L/M/N/O results and logical non-implications. It adds no physical theory, external time, or claim of phenomenological proof.

feature_status.immanent_reflexivity: conditional typing constraint; no unique graph selector
feature_status.retentional_thickness: weakly motivated; AP3N order added and AP3O successor not derived
feature_status.maximality: AP3G implementation feature; not grammar-independent mode definition

adequacy_countermodel.shows: family constraint does not entail GrammarAdequacy for one member

enrichment_countermodel.shows: not universally required does not imply non-content

boundary_countermodel.shows: context maximality does not entail mode-component identity

restricted_conclusion: The four-feature strategy correctly gives a unified family-constraint research programme, but it does not make one grammar adequate, optional enrichments unreal, or successor-components modes. The common interface remains; the three debts require distinct adequacy, enrichment, and component-to-mode bridges unless an independently warranted stronger self-presentation theorem is supplied.
